prompt:
Use case: substantial structural redraw of a game character after a specific visual critique.
IMAGE 1 is the youthful gentle silver-haired butterfly girl to improve. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY references for how this game's clothing construction, directional silhouette, large value planes and body-weight/pose read clearly. Do not copy those adult women's physiques, faces, clothes or weapons.
The user approved this correction: the current sleeves look like flat repeated round-petal boards and hide the body. Rebuild real butterfly-shaped CLOTH SLEEVES with a root, unequal lobes, folds, turned surfaces, depth and gravitational drape; then coordinate the shoulders, waist and legs. This must visibly address the structure, NOT merely repaint the same flat round silhouette.

PRESERVE IDENTITY AND TONE:
Same cute gentle youthful girl, rounded lavender-eyed face and small warm smile, long silver-white hair, two curved black-purple horns, pointed elf ears, purple/ivory Chinese CROSS-COLLAR hanfu with small simple cloud shoulders, below-knee layered skirt, fully opaque purple leggings and low modest cloth boots. Compact approximately 3.5 actual head heights excluding horns, retain her sweet youthful proportions and modest nonsexual outfit. Warm gentle personality and three-quarter SCREEN LEFT orientation.
Reduce the oversized horns' height about 15 percent without losing their paired curved silhouette. Gather the rear white hair into one quieter slimmer mass and 2–3 broad locks; reduce its lateral spread about 20 percent to expose the far shoulder, elbow and sleeve. No numerous pointed hair shards.

MOST IMPORTANT — REDESIGN THE SLEEVE CUT AND CONSTRUCTION:
Only TWO real wide sleeves, each attached at its shoulder and upper arm and ending in a clear cuff around the wrist. No independent back wings or extra skirt-wing slabs.
Each outer sleeve silhouette has ONE LARGE LONG UPPER BUTTERFLY LOBE plus ONE SMALLER TAPERED LOWER LOBE, joined by a meaningful concave notch. Unequal large/small shapes; softer curved leading edge, a short decisive angled fold transition, tapering lower trailing tip. Eliminate the current row of three/four evenly rounded flower petals. A believable tailored butterfly sleeve, not a literal flower fan or rigid board.
Near sleeve is lifted by the bent near forearm and hangs in a broad diagonal gravity-driven drape from elbow to its low corner. Show a clear fabric-root gathering near upper arm/cuff, one LARGE fold ridge, a DARK TURNED-UNDER BACK SURFACE and a broad lit outward face. Near cuff visibly encircles wrist. The sleeve's rounded butterfly silhouette must survive this fold.
Far sleeve is partly foreshortened and turned edge-on, noticeably narrower than the near sleeve; its butterfly motif is partly hidden by the fold. It must NOT show a second complete front-facing flat copy of the near wing.
Apply ONLY ONE broad pale-lavender/cyan asymmetric wing-eye band to the exposed near sleeve and a partially visible corresponding band on far sleeve. The pigment bends WITH the cloth, changes value in shadow, and disappears around the turn. Do not paste a flat pale pattern on top of shading. The sleeve's silhouette and fabric motion provide the butterfly theme even without patterns.

SIMPLIFY AND ORGANIZE:
Keep the waist as a plain purple cloth sash with one SMALL flat jade clasp; remove butterfly-logo belt buckle, repeated butterfly skirt stamps, repeated diamond chains and repeated cloud stamps. Keep one quiet cloud-shaped shoulder edge rather than a swirl stamped everywhere. Plain ivory overlapping skirt panel, only a broad purple hem edge. No added jewelry or trailing strings.
Retain the ONE little lavender butterfly hovering just above her near palm as a story/gesture accent; no more detached butterflies or particles. The only major decorative emphasis is the butterfly sleeves and the face/forehead.
Allow clean gaps to distinguish elbow from waist and legs from skirt. The body must not disappear inside a circular mass of hair/sleeves.

POSE — GENTLE ASYMMETRICAL STANDING WITH VISIBLE WEIGHT:
Whole face/chest/hips/boots three-quarter left about 40 degrees, far shoulder and eye foreshortened. Near hand softly upturned at chin height with butterfly above it, relaxed fingers and real palm anatomy. Near shoulder slightly raised by that elbow, far shoulder comfortably lower. FAR hand now rests LOW BESIDE THE WAIST, gently gathering its own sleeve edge rather than crossing over and hiding both arms. Both wrists and cuffs connect clearly to their own forearms.
One leg bears her weight under the hip; the other knee gently softens and the foot sits a little behind/to the side. Narrow but clear gap between two boots, no parallel stiff legs, no crossed/merged legs, no wide warrior stance. Small natural counter-angle between shoulder line and pelvis, restrained and appropriate to a youthful character; not adult hip posing. Both soles rest naturally on the implied ground. Head gently inclined toward the little butterfly with a warm curious expression.

DRAWING STYLE MATCH:
Like images 2 and 3, use 2–3 clear coherent matte light/shadow groups that DESCRIBE FORM AND FOLDS. Confident dark contour with intentional curved versus angular transitions, restrained inner lines. Broad shadow of back hair, firm large turned sleeve plane, simple clean skirt fold groups. No smooth airbrushed candy rendering, no evenly flat decorative stickers, no tiny triangular mosaic, no glitter, no crystalline skin or clothing, no realistic eyes.
One complete full-body figure safely inside square warm-ivory background, full horns/little butterfly/sleeves/feet with clear 7–8 percent margins. No panel, inset rectangle, text, scene, floor shadow, weapon, or comparison sheet. Make the sleeve construction and asymmetric silhouette visibly NEW while preserving the original girl's charm.
purpose: User-approved structural correction following comparison with the female dao fighter and archer.
visual_review: Near sleeve now has unequal lobes and a longer tapered lower section; far sleeve is narrower and turned. Torso/waist are more exposed by reduced hair/sleeve overlap; skirt stamp removed. Gentle face, guofeng cross-collar outfit and complete three-quarter standing silhouette retained.
